editor.draftA11y: Writing area — type your text in German.
editor.previewA11y: Annotated preview — tap an underline to see the correction.

live.fallbackBanner: Fallback corrections · the Betreuer is temporarily unavailable.

permission.title: Camera access
permission.body: To photograph your handwritten answer, let DeutschFit use the camera.

tips.frame: Fit the whole sheet in frame, with no edge cut off.
tips.light: Find a well-lit spot with no shadow across the page.
tips.legible: Check that your handwriting is sharp and easy to read.

caption.ready: Fit your sheet inside the frame
caption.captured: Check that the text is sharp

errors.notDeployed: Handwritten grading is coming soon — your photo was captured but won't be analysed for now.
errors.uploadFailed: Upload failed. Check your connection and try again.
errors.imageNotUploaded: Your photo couldn't be sent to the server. Retake the photo and try again.
errors.idempotencyConflict: A grading request is already in flight for this submission. Wait a few seconds and try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many submissions in a short period. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.graderError: Automatic grading is temporarily unavailable. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.graderTimeout: Grading took too long. Try again.
errors.regradeLimitExceeded: You've already retried this submission three times. Head back to your results or start a new exercise.

review.caption: Here's what we read on your sheet
review.previewA11y: Tap to zoom your captured photo
review.previewMissing: Photo preview is unavailable. Your transcription is still readable below.

errors.fetchBody: We couldn't load the transcription. Check your connection and try again.
errors.notDeployed: Automatic re-reading is coming soon. Hang tight and check back for your correction.

unreadable.title: We couldn't read your photo
unreadable.body: We didn't find any handwritten German on your photo. Make sure the sheet is well lit and sharp, and that you're photographing your handwriting — not a screen or typed text.

failed.title: We couldn't grade your submission
failed.body: Something went wrong on the grading side. You can retake a photo or try again in a few minutes.

offTopic.title: Off-topic answer — we still graded your text.
offTopic.body: Your draft doesn't address the prompt, but your German is still useful: here's what you wrote, your dimension scores and corrections. Retry whenever you want to practise on the right format.
